sloka: तेन कांचन रोम्णा तु मणि प्रवर शृंगिणा ।तरुण आदित्य वर्णेन नक्षत्र पथ वर्चसा ॥३-४३-२२॥
transliteration: tena kāṁcana romṇā tu maṇi pravara śṛṁgiṇā ।taruṇa āditya varṇena nakṣatra patha varcasā ॥3-43-22॥

translations.english: On hearing Sita's words and seeing the wonderful deer, Rama was tempted by its appearance.Prompted by Sita,he joyfully said this to Lakshmana:
